subject: Alder river otter
verdict: self-approved as a convincing stylized river otter and polished five-performance land study; first submission awaits independent parent audit

brief.physicalInterpretation: living river otter in a quiet chestnut and silvery muzzle sculpture
brief.identity: elongated low torso, short limbs, broad webbed five-toed paws, small ears, integrated whiskered muzzle, muscular tapered tail
brief.gesture: low curious exploration; elastic quicker bound; unhurried seated cheek wash
brief.display: native clay multiview and consumer desktop/390 px

views.judgment: Identity reads in clay. Side separates long low trunk from short limb chains and continuous tapered tail. Front retains broad muzzle, tiny ears and five-toed paw spread. Rear shows fitted tail root and stance.
Quiet coat planes retain form; darker wet nose and eyes separate from pale muzzle without a mask-like hard boundary. Whiskers remain visible at consumer scale.

Enlarged extremes and intermediate rise show continuous neck, belly and tail, with raised paw approaching cheek. Abdomen crease remains stylized, without the rejected hard side-weight pull. Bound gathers limbs below the low trunk.

390 px portrait retains full body/tail and readable muzzle, with no horizontal overflow. Front consumer view exposes the seated wash gesture. Stock desktop camera leaves generous margins; orbit and zoom remain available.

idle.review: Actual 1x and 3 Hz decoded playback: restrained breathing, curious head/ear responses and delayed tail sway; planted paws and loop closure.

walk.review: Actual 1x repeated cycles and 12 Hz decoded gait: staggered low steps, short recovery, supported trunk and tail response. Travel endpoint applies authored trajectory once.

bound.review: Actual 1x repeated cycles and 12 Hz decoded gait: stronger gather, suspended exchange and hind drive distinguish it from the walk. Compression is stylized rather than calibrated animal gait.

scent.review: Actual 1x and 4 Hz decoded playback: lower into ground-oriented investigation, small searching sweeps and measured recovery; four paws remain planted.

groom.review: Actual 1x and 4 Hz decoded playback: settle back, lift forepaws, bring left paw to cheek for two gentle strokes, lower and recover. Inspected intermediate rise and enlarged seated neck/abdomen.

repairs.defect: Initial clay muzzle and ears overpowered the elongated otter body.
repairs.repair: Shortened saved muzzle projection by 20 percent beyond x=1.1 and reduced ear height/projection.

repairs.defect: Initial voxel tail tip had visible ripples.
repairs.repair: Locally relaxed the saved tip without rebuilding the mesh; mild sculptural tip irregularity remains.
Restricted pale gradient to central torso/head region.

repairs.defect: First grooming gesture stayed low on three paws and read as a chin rub.
repairs.repair: Authored a seated torso/pelvis gesture, lifted both forepaws and oriented washing paw toward cheek.

repairs.defect: Strong seated pose pulled side abdomen into raised forelimb.
repairs.repair: Smoothed limb weighting through a lateral gate on existing saved geometry; reduced chest/spine pitch and lowered head toward paw.

repairs.defect: Initial export exceeded the delivery budget at 212024 triangles and about 8.5 MB.
repairs.repair: Simplified redundant body/toe/claw/whisker triangles on copied native candidates; final 100140 triangles and 3940712 bytes.

repairs.defect: Frame-zero reference for planted height could be a swinging paw.
repairs.repair: Probe every actual toe/web sole against explicit z=0.018 support plane; retained thresholds.

repairs.defect: Enlarged review camera target conditional aimed outside the subject.
repairs.repair: Corrected expression grouping and rerendered final extremes.

limits: Owner self-review is neither independent approval nor user approval.
Stylized sculpture, flat planted paw orientation and simplified spine; no motion capture, muscle correctives, calibrated biomechanics or synchronized animal-reference fidelity.
Discrete support audits and sparse vertex native/browser agreement do not establish continuous collision-free motion.
Minor tail-tip irregularity and gentle abdomen crease are retained stylistic limits.
No swimming, water or fur simulation.
Recipes bootstrap fresh starting candidates; saved native refinements and masters are authoritative.
retention: Native renders and enlarged decoded sheets retained as full-resolution JPEG q=2 copies; original PNGs remain in named local review runs. Actual 1x movies are unchanged.
